summary: gRPC-Java 1.75 contains a bug that corrupts network streams when multiple versions of Netty are present on the classpath, causing Temporal workers to fail randomly with 'Encountered end-of-stream mid-frame' errors. The issue is fixed in gRPC-Java 1.76.
userImpact: Workers fail randomly with gRPC stream corruption errors when multiple Netty versions are present in the classpath.
rootCause: gRPC-Java 1.75 has a bug in handling Netty dependencies when other versions of Netty are present on the classpath in addition to gRPC-Java's shaded copy.
resolutionDetails: Fixed by upgrading gRPC-Java from version 1.75 to 1.76.
keyQuote: gRPC-Java version 1.75 contains a bug related to Netty which can corrupt network stream in certain situations when other versions of Netty are present in the classpath
